01Profile

Who's behind the architecture

Grow Infinitely...

I'm an AI-SaaS engineer in Dhaka. My work sits where machine learning, software engineering, and security collide. I build systems that are precise, hold up under real traffic, and stay secure while doing it.

At Maktech I lead AI-SaaS engineering, taking products from a rough brief through architecture, build, and deployment. I work for clients internationally, mostly full-stack AI and SaaS builds.

My core stack is Python and FastAPI on the backend, React/Next and TypeScript on the front, with PostgreSQL, Docker, and CI around it. Where a project needs models rather than APIs, I work in PyTorch and TensorFlow - and I care as much about the auth, payment, and deployment layers as the model itself, because that is where products actually break.

02Services

What I can run for you

Currently working full-time at Maktech, dedicated to building scalable solutions that solve real product needs.

AI Product Engineering

End-to-end SaaS builds - FastAPI backends, React front ends, Postgres schemas, auth and payments. Delivered as something you can hand to users, not a prototype that needs a rewrite.

LLM & RAG Systems

Retrieval pipelines over your own data using pgvector, ChromaDB, or Pinecone - with evaluation, cost control, and fallbacks, so answers stay grounded instead of confidently wrong.

Backend & API Design

Typed, documented REST APIs with OpenAPI, sane migrations, and background jobs. Built so the next engineer can read the codebase without a handover call.

Deployment & Security

Dockerised deploys, CI pipelines, health checks, and hardened headers. A network-security background, applied to the boring parts that decide whether a launch holds.
